name: vibld
description: Build and edit vibld websites and web apps from your coding agent: start a build, follow it, read and change the code, type-check it and see it in a browser.

interface.shortDescription: Build and edit vibld sites and apps from a conversation.
interface.longDescription: Adds vibld's MCP server (https://app.vibld.com/mcp) and skills for building a project and editing its code. The code stays a plain Vite, React, TypeScript and Tailwind project you can export. Documentation is at https://vibld.com/docs.
